_about: AICP-365: the probe (segment 1 alone, no voice reference) prompts of project 46cc6443 as run on Seedance 2.5, verbatim from the orchestrator refs (refs/{pt,pl,fr}_run_inputs.json 'seg1_probe'), plus each run's stitch order. Read with tests/fixtures/localisation_46cc6443.json.

probe.pt:
Keep the main person in the reference video exactly as they are. Do not replace the character: their face, identity, hair, clothing and appearance must stay the same person throughout, unchanged from the reference video. Re-speak the assigned dialogue in portuguese (from english to portuguese). Naturally adapt mouth shapes, lip movements and timing to lip-sync the translated speech; also adapt facial expressions, emotional reactions and speaker behavior where the translated delivery requires it. Preserve framing, camera movement, background, lighting, props, phone or tablet screens and their contents, captions and other on-screen text. Preserve overall action, choreography and body movement except for natural speech-related adjustments — do not freeze the original face or mouth motion. Each visually grounded speaker must say only the dialogue assigned to that speaker; do not swap lines between on-screen and off-screen speakers.

Speakers:
- WOMAN: the older woman with glasses. She owns the phone. Mature, lower voice.
- INTERVIEWER: a young WOMAN off screen — only her hand holding the microphone is visible. Female, higher-pitched voice. Never a male voice.

Dialogue — spoken strictly in this order, at these times (seconds from the start of this clip), nothing before or after:
[0.0–2.4] WOMAN: Acho que leio bem mais livros por isso.
[2.4–4.2] INTERVIEWER: Com licença, como lê tanto?
[4.3–6.2] WOMAN: Eu não leio, eu escuto.
[6.3–7.3] INTERVIEWER: Como assim?
[7.5–12.1] WOMAN: Eu tenho um app: tiro uma foto do livro e ele lê tudo pra mim.
